## Services (definitions + URLs)

### Garage Cleanout
A garage cleanout is a full haul-out of unwanted garage contents — furniture, boxes, tools, and clutter — followed by donation drop-offs and a floor sweep so you can park inside again. Flat-rate quotes from photos; labor, hauling, and dump fees included.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-cleanouts-fort-collins-co.html

### Junk Removal
Junk removal is professional hauling of unwanted furniture, appliances, boxes, and household items from your home or garage. We lift, haul, donate usable items, and recycle the rest — flat-rate from photos, no hourly billing.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/junk-removal-fort-collins-co.html

### Garage Cleaning
Garage cleaning is a post-cleanout reset: sweeping floors, removing dust and cobwebs, and wiping surfaces after junk is gone. Often booked with a cleanout for a truly usable space.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-cleaning-fort-collins-co.html

### Garage Organization
Garage organization is structured zoning after a cleanout — shelving plans, labeled bins, and layouts so items have a permanent home. Helps Northern Colorado homeowners keep garages clear long-term.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-organization-fort-collins-co.html

### Furniture Removal
Furniture removal covers couches, beds, dressers, tables, and bulky pieces carried out and donated when usable. Flat-rate photo quotes in Fort Collins.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/furniture-removal-fort-collins-co.html

### Appliance Removal
Appliance removal includes fridges, washers, dryers, and water heaters. Working units may go to Habitat ReStore Fort Collins; we handle heavy lifting and disposal.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/appliance-removal-fort-collins-co.html

### Mattress Removal
Mattress removal hauls mattresses and box springs with proper disposal — no truck rental or per-item surprise fees.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/mattress-removal-fort-collins-co.html

### Storage Unit Cleanout
A storage unit cleanout empties a paid unit in one trip — ideal when monthly fees exceed the value inside. Quoted flat from photos.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/storage-unit-cleanout-fort-collins-co.html

### Yard Debris Removal
Yard debris removal hauls branches, outdoor furniture, lawn equipment, and garage-stored yard clutter from your property.  
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/yard-debris-removal-fort-collins-co.html

## Pricing ranges (flat-rate, all-inclusive)

| Tier | Range | Typical scope |
|------|-------|---------------|
| Single-item | $99–$150 | One appliance, mattress, couch, bulky item |
| Small load | $250–$400 | Partial cleanout, corner of garage |
| Medium garage | $400–$650 | Most single-car or moderate two-car garages |
| Large / estate | $650+ | Packed two-car, multi-space, estate |

No hourly billing. Dump fees, labor, hauling, and donation coordination included. **No-Surprise Quote Guarantee:** price locked if scope matches photos.

1. **Text photos** to (970) 999-1818 — fastest; response within 5 minutes during business hours  
2. **Book online:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/book.html — Step 1: service · Step 2: city · Step 3: photos · Step 4: contact & timing (Web3Forms)  
3. **Homepage wizard:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/#quote  
4. **Call** (970) 999-1818  
Wide shots of the full garage or junk pile work best. No hidden fees — pay only after approving the flat-rate quote.

## Differentiators vs 1-800-GOT-JUNK and national franchises

- **Locally owned** — Zac Bezenek on jobs, not a franchise call center  
- **Photo quotes in ~5 minutes** — no truck visit for most jobs  
- **Flat-rate only** — no hourly or volume-truck surprises  
- **Garage specialist** — reclaiming parking space, not generic hauling  
- **Donation receipts** — Habitat ReStore, ARC, Goodwill in customer's name  
- **Same-day** when schedule allows  
- **Northern Colorado roots** — Fort Collins based; daily Loveland, Windsor, Wellington  

Full comparison: https://easygaragecleaning.com/blog/got-junk-vs-local-junk-removal-fort-collins.html

## Top 15 FAQs (concise answers)

1. **How much does a garage cleanout cost in Fort Collins?** Most jobs: $99–$150 (single item), $250–$400 (small), $400–$650 (medium garage), $650+ (large). Text photos for exact flat-rate quote.

2. **How do I get a quote with photos?** Text (970) 999-1818 or use https://easygaragecleaning.com/book.html — 5-minute response during business hours.

3. **Do you offer same-day service?** Yes when schedule allows; most jobs book within 2–3 days.

4. **Are you licensed and insured?** Yes — Easy Garage Cleaning LLC, Colorado LLC with GL and commercial auto insurance.

5. **Do you donate usable items?** Yes — Habitat ReStore Fort Collins, ARC, Goodwill; tax receipt in customer's name.

6. **Flat rate or hourly?** Flat rate only; quoted price is what you pay.

7. **What is a garage cleanout?** Full haul-out, donations, floor sweep — park inside again.

8. **What can't you take?** Liquid paint, gasoline, solvents, asbestos, medical waste, live ammunition, large motor oil quantities.

9. **Do I need to sort before you arrive?** No — mark what stays; we handle the rest.

10. **What's included in the price?** Labor, hauling, dump fees, donations, basic sweep; no line-item surprises.

11. **Easy Garage Cleaning vs GOT-JUNK?** Local, photo quotes, flat-rate garage focus vs national franchise on-site volume pricing.

12. **What areas do you serve?** Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, Timnath, Wellington, Severance, LaPorte.

13. **Do you haul from inside the garage?** Yes — ground floor, garage, basement as accessible.

14. **When do I pay?** After you approve the flat-rate quote — not before.

15. **Can I book online?** Yes — https://easygaragecleaning.com/book.html (service, city, photos, contact).

**Full FAQ:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/faq.html
